$ backup run --help
Usage: backup run [options]

Write an archive of the store to a bucket.

Options:
      --bucket string               Bucket that receives the archive.  required, env BACKUP_RUN_BUCKET, key run.bucket
  -z, --compression none|gzip|zstd  Compression of the archive.        default "zstd", env BACKUP_RUN_COMPRESSION, key run.compression
  -n, --dry-run                     Print the plan without a backup.   env BACKUP_RUN_DRY_RUN, key run.dry-run
      --endpoint string             Endpoint of the object store.      default "https://s3.example.com", env BACKUP_RUN_ENDPOINT, key storage.endpoint
      --retain int                  Number of archives to keep.        default "7", env BACKUP_RUN_RETAIN, key run.retain
      --schedule string             Cron schedule of the next backup.
      --token string                Access token of the bucket.        env BACKUP_TOKEN, key run.token

Global options:
  -c, --config file  Config file in JSON.                                                    env BACKUP_CONFIG
      --flag-debug   Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env BACKUP_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help         Show the help.
[exit 0]

$ backup run
backup: run: missing --bucket
[exit 2]

$ backup run --bucket nightly
archive nightly with zstd, keep 7, endpoint https://s3.example.com
[exit 0]

$ backup run --bucket nightly --retain 3 -z gzip -n
archive nightly with gzip, keep 3, endpoint https://s3.example.com
dry run: nothing written
[exit 0]

$ backup run --bucket nightly --schedule '0 3 * * *'
archive nightly with zstd, keep 7, endpoint https://s3.example.com
schedule the next backup at "0 3 * * *"
[exit 0]

$ cat backup.json
{"storage": {"endpoint": "https://minio.internal"}}
$ backup -c backup.json run --bucket nightly
archive nightly with zstd, keep 7, endpoint https://minio.internal
[exit 0]

$ BACKUP_RUN_RETAIN=14 BACKUP_TOKEN=s3cret backup run --bucket nightly --flag-debug
  OPTION         VALUE                     SOURCE
  --config       ""                        default
  --bucket       "nightly"                 flag --bucket
  --compression  "zstd"                    default
  --dry-run      false                     default
  --endpoint     "https://s3.example.com"  default
  --retain       14                        env BACKUP_RUN_RETAIN
  --schedule     ""                        default
  --token        ***                       env BACKUP_TOKEN
archive nightly with zstd, keep 14, endpoint https://s3.example.com
authenticate with the token
[exit 0]

$ backup run --bucket nightly -z rar
backup: run: invalid --compression "rar" from flag --compression: want none, gzip or zstd
[exit 2]

$ backup run --bucket nightly >/dev/full
backup: main: write the plan: clitest: no space left on device
[exit 1]
